summary: More iptables examples: inserting at rule 5, setting INPUT policy to DROP (can lock you out), rejecting with tcp-reset, TCP flags, flushing filter and nat chains, logging with rate limits, and multiport rules.
questions: How do I insert an iptables rule at line 5?
How do I flush all iptables rules with Ansible?
Will setting INPUT policy to DROP lock me out?
How do I log packets with a rate limit?
How do I allow ports 80, 443 and a range in one rule?

answer_card.title: iptables examples (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.iptables:
    chain: INPUT
    protocol: tcp
    destination_port: 8080
    jump: ACCEPT
    action: insert
    rule_num: 5
- ansible.builtin.iptables: {chain: INPUT, policy: DROP}   # may lock you out!
- ansible.builtin.iptables: {chain: "{{ item }}", flush: yes}
  with_items: [INPUT, FORWARD, OUTPUT]
- ansible.builtin.iptables:
    chain: LOGGING
    limit: 2/second
    limit_burst: 20
    log_prefix: "IPTABLES:INFO: "
    log_level: info
- ansible.builtin.iptables:
    chain: INPUT
    protocol: tcp
    destination_ports: ["80", "443", "8081:8083"]
    jump: ACCEPT
```
